tools.name: eudr_products
tools.description: The full list of products in scope of the EUDR (Annex I), with application dates and sources. Uses the free tier, or the caller's API key.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "eu_trade_quotas" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: cn, country, order_number, celex, history, cursor, limit

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_watched_tenders, sanctions_list_changes · Private data: get_tender_deadline_changes, cbam_default_values, cbam_certificate_price, cbam_countries, eu_contract_awards, get_eu_contract_award, sanctions_list_changes, eu_funding_changes, eu_trade_defence_measures, eu_trade_quotas, sanctions_search, sanctions_entry, eu_compliance_deadlines, eu_compliance_deadline, eudr_scope, eudr_products · Public sink: list_watched_tenders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_watched_tenders, sanctions_list_changes · Private data: get_tender_deadline_changes, cbam_default_values, cbam_certificate_price, cbam_countries, eu_contract_awards, get_eu_contract_award, sanctions_list_changes, eu_funding_changes, eu_trade_defence_measures, eu_trade_quotas, sanctions_search, sanctions_entry, eu_compliance_deadlines, eu_compliance_deadline, eudr_scope, eudr_products · Public sink: list_watched_tenders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "cbam_default_values" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The EU's official CBAM default embedded-emission values for a CN code, by country of origin and year, with the cost per tonne at the current certificate price and links to the implementing regulation. Free." → after: "The EU's official CBAM default embedded-emission values for a CN code, by country of origin and year, with the cost per tonne at the current certificate price and links to the implementing regulation. Uses the free tier, or the caller's API key."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
